install.userOwnedExclusion: Only the installer-managed skill tree under skills/pipeline is removed on uninstall. Unrelated user skills and files outside the managed tree are preserved.
install.postInstall: Restart Codex to pick it up, then invoke with $pipeline.

early_run_handoff.how: Parse durable run handoff JSON from stdout for run_id and events path; fall back to status / run-store discovery when handoff line is missed.

event_follow.how: pipeline logs <run-id> --events --follow (or loop logs) until terminal.

reattach.how: Re-arm event follow / wait after cancelled or lost follow; cancelled wait is not terminal.

wait_cancel.how: Cancelled wait before terminal is non-terminal; re-follow events.jsonl until run_complete / loop terminal.

material_progress_notify.how: Poll/follow material stream; concise chat/status updates. Never requires Claude PushNotification.
material_progress_notify.fallback: stdout material lines via events.jsonl + material-filter.mjs

terminal_cleanup.how: Stop event follows for this run_id on terminal; leave run store intact.

terminal_summary.how: Surface terminal JSON / pipeline summary <run-id>; optional loop --audit.
